race.comment: The Stokes yard has scratched ANAHORISH and leaving the job to stablemate CHICA ASTUTA (9). Fitter for two runs back and looks ready to win. Placed here over 1250m last time and despite a tricky draw is likely to push forward and give a sight. BOOLCUNDA DAWN (2) hit the line nicely fresh over the 1100m on the main track. Fitter and can improve sharply over this longer journey. DIVERSITY (1) is a former Freedman-trained galloper who was tested in stakes class at Eagle Farm in the late autumn. First run for the new yard and returns fitter for two trials. Worth keeping safe. TRANTORO (8) is close to a win and expected in the finish.
